$comment: The canonical project tree, declared once (ADR-001 amendment 10): a host that names this profile (`layout.profile: "monorepo"`) has these places as layout-floor rows, derived, and adds only its own entries. Every app lives in platform/apps/<app>/ (backend/, frontend/ inside it); the kits in platform/kits/; the host's ops in ops/{cli,config,deploy}; its documents in docs/.
